column1: This tab contains median age at death by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander origin from 1997 to 2025. It ranges from cell A1 to C40.
Table 12.16 Median age at death by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander origin, NSW, QLD, SA, WA and NT, 1997-2025 (a)(b)(c)(d)

(a) Causes of death data for recent years is preliminary and subject to a revisions process. This table includes final data for 2016-2022, revised data for 2023, preliminary revised data for 2024 and preliminary data for 2025.
(b) Data is by date of registration.
(c) Data is reported by usual residence for NSW, Qld, WA, SA and NT only. Data for Vic, Tas and ACT is excluded in line with national reporting guidelines.
(d) Median age is the age at death where half the people were older, and half were younger.
